messages.subject: input text not updated
parts:
Hi !

I have something that I don't understand when I try to update the value of an input text. My code is the following :

ui.R
shinyUI(bootstrapPage(
  div(class="container",
      actionButton('bt_apply','apply'),
      uiOutput('datas_set'))     
  )
)

server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
 
  foo <- reactiveValues(bar = 'a')
 
  observe({
   
    if(input$bt_apply == 0)
      return (NULL);
   
    cat('observe bt_apply\n')
   
    foo$bar=NULL
    foo$bar='a'
   
  })
 
  output$datas_set <- renderUI({
    cat(paste0('output$datas_set : ', foo$bar, '\n'))
#     return(HTML(paste0('<input type="text" id="', as.integer(runif(1,1,100)), '" value="', foo$bar, '"/>')))
    return(HTML(paste0('<input type="text" id="aId" value="', foo$bar, '"/>')))
  })
})


I except that each time the button is pressed the value manualy entered (lets say 'b') in the input text is deleted and the input text is recreate with the value 'a' , however this in not the case and the value 'b' is still in the input text. I see the updateTextInput function but as I have variable number of input I don't really want to use it.
One more thing, if a use the commented line it works ...

Do you have any idee ?

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: Re: input text not updated
parts:
I believe it's to do with Shiny's default behaviour. For all components and reactives Shiny caches the values being computed. If the computation output produces the same output as cached then it does not do anything further. 

In this specific case each time the button is pressed the output$data_set outputs the same HTML so Shiny does not do anything further with it. Whereas if you set the id to some random number then the HTML looks different hence Shiny will go ahead and perform the action. A hacky way to force shiny to output it would be to randomise some part of the HTML as you have done.

I wonder if there is a non-hacky way to do this.

Out of curiosity why does having variable number of inputs prevent you from you using updateTextInput?
